```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```

## R Markdown


```{r cars}
df <- read.csv("data/filtered_marathons_results.csv")
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    isMale = as.integer(ifelse(M.F == "F", 0, 1)),
    City = as.factor(City),
    State = as.factor(State),
    Country = as.factor(Country),
    Parathletics = as.integer(ifelse(Parathletics == "No", 0, 1)),
    X5K = as.numeric(hms(X5K)),
    X10K = as.numeric(hms(X10K)),
    X15K = as.numeric(hms(X15K)),
    X20K = as.numeric(hms(X20K)),
    Half = as.numeric(hms(Half)),
    X25K = as.numeric(hms(X25K)),
    X30K = as.numeric(hms(X30K)),
    X35K = as.numeric(hms(X35K)),
    X40K = as.numeric(hms(X40K)),
    Pace = as.numeric(hms(Pace)),
    Proj.Time = as.numeric(hms(Proj.Time)),
    Official.Time = as.numeric(hms(Official.Time))
  )
summary(df)
```
```{r}
glimpse(df)
```


## Including Plots


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Runners' Ages", x = "Age", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = Official.Time / 3600)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Age vs. Official Finish Time",
    x = "Age", y = "Finish Time (Hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# df_temp <- df %>% select(isMale, Official.Time)
# df_temp$GenderLabel <- ifelse(df$isMale == 1, "Male", "Female")

ggplot(df, aes(x = M.F, y = Official.Time / 3600, fill = M.F)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Finish Time Distribution by Gender",
    x = "Gender", y = "Finish Time (Hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Calculate Second Half time
df_temp <- df %>% select(Half)
df_temp$SecondHalf <- df$Official.Time - df$Half

ggplot(df_temp, aes(x = Half, y = SecondHalf)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "First Half vs. Second Half Split Times",
    subtitle = "Points above the red line slowed down in the second half",
    x = "First Half (Seconds)", y = "Second Half (Seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
df %>%
  filter(Country != "USA") %>%
  count(Country) %>%
  top_n(10, n) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Country, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 International Countries", x = "Country", y = "Number of Runners") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = Official.Time / 3600, group = Year)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Finish Times by Year", x = "Year", y = "Finish Time (Hours)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
